reason: power loss; every chain checkpointed at sweep 16,000
bit_identical: the checkpointed state carries the sweep-end RNG, so the resumed draw sequence is the one the uninterrupted run would have produced; retained draws are spliced with no gap and no overlap (block 0 retains sweeps 15,000-15,995, the resumed portion 16,000-49,995, both on the registered thin of 5)

not_restored.movement_series_and_summary: cover sweeps 16,000-50,000 only; the tracker for sweeps 0-16,000 died with the interrupted process and was never on disk
not_restored.acceptance_rates: post-burn-in counters restart at 16,000, so rates omit sweeps 15,000-16,000 (1,000 of 35,000 post-burn-in sweeps); whole-run totals in proposed/accepted are intact from the checkpointed state
not_restored.table_builds: counts the resumed 34,000 sweeps only, so performance.json's builds_equal_sweeps reads false
not_restored.runtime: per-chain runtime_seconds and the wall clock cover the resumed portion; the pre-interruption portion ran 2026-08-14 10:40-16:22 BST

configuration_changes: none; corpus, scales, schedule, seeds and sweep order are the freeze manifest's
